M04-set-cache-clear.desc: set() no longer clears the target cell's own context cache.

M05-cache-value-update.desc: cache_result() no longer writes the result into cell.value, so chained formulas reading a snapshot of a computed formula see a stale/null value.

M06-min-array-max.desc: The min() array helper computes a MAX instead of a min.

M07-stale-ready.desc: propagate() marks dependents Ready instead of Stale after a dependency change (lying status bit).
